FANTOM5 ligand-receptor database – rat

Source: R/data.R
ncomms8866_rat.Rd

Rat ortholog-mapped ligand-receptor pairs derived from the human FANTOM5 table (Ramilowski et al., 2015) using the methodology of Raredon et al. (2019). This is the table loaded when load_LRM_database("fantom5", species = "rat") is called.

Format

A data.frame with one row per ligand-receptor pair and the following key columns:

Ligand.ApprovedSymbol

Rat gene symbol for the ligand (character).

Receptor.ApprovedSymbol

Rat gene symbol for the receptor (character).

Additional annotation columns are retained where ortholog mapping was possible.

Source

Ramilowski, J.A. et al. (2015). A draft network of ligand-receptor-mediated multicellular signalling in human. Nature Communications, 6, 7866. doi:10.1038/ncomms8866

See also

load_LRM_database for the recommended user interface; ncomms8866, ncomms8866_human, ncomms8866_mouse, ncomms8866_pig.

Examples

# \donttest{
db <- load_LRM_database("fantom5", species = "rat")
#> [load_LRM_database] Loading FANTOM5 (rat) from bundled package data ...
#> [load_LRM_database] FANTOM5 (rat): 2557 unique LR pairs loaded.
head(db)
#>   ligand receptor
#> 1    A2m     Lrp1
#> 2  Aanat   Mtnr1a
#> 3  Aanat   Mtnr1b
#> 4    Ace    Agtr2
#> 5    Ace   Bdkrb2
#> 6 Adam10      Axl
nrow(db)
#> [1] 2557
# }
